segments.text:
If Christ be so glorious, how should Believers long to be with
him, and behold him in his glory above? Most men need patience to dye, a Believer should need patience to live. Paul thought it well worth enduring the pangs of death, to get a sight of Jesus Christ in his glory, Phil. 1. 23. The Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and patient waiting for of Christ, (saith the Apostle) 2 Thes. 3. 5. intimating that the Saints have great need of patience to enable them to endure the state of distance and separation from Christ, so long as they must endure it in this world. The Spirit and the Bride say come, and let him that heareth say come, and let him that is a thirst come, even so come Lord Jesus, and be thou as a swift Roe upon the Mountains of Separation.
